title: One Writable Folder
description: The run command that gives an agent exactly one read-write mount, with the reference mount read-only.

steps.description: Run interactively and remove the container on exit, naming it `agent`. The page says the discipline that makes everything safe is one read-write mount and everything else read-only or absent.
Mount `$HOME/agents/project` at `/work` read-write. The page says this folder is a git repository, so every change the agent makes is listed by `git status` and revertible with `git checkout`.
Mount `$HOME/notes/vault` at `/reference` with `:ro`. The page says the agent reads these and physically cannot modify them.

Pass `AGENT_API_KEY` through from your shell with `-e` and no value, which the page says avoids baking the key into the image or its history. The course's own stack needs no key, because the model is local.
